title: Masar Map 2 scenarios: simulated departures, OEJN runways 34C and 34L
assumptions: Simulated flights, not recorded ones. The aircraft follows the published SID exactly and keeps to its published altitude and speed limits (AIP AMDT 10/26).
Fuel comes from OpenAP: take-off mass 80% of the maximum take-off mass, the standard OpenAP (WRAP) climb, 250 kt below 10,000 ft and no wind.
Fuel, CO2, time and distance cover only the climb from brake release to 10,000 ft. CO2 = fuel x 3.16.
Noise is the loudest moment of one departure (LAmax), from ECAC Doc 29 through the noise model of the oejn-noise-population repo: daytime, still air, 33 °C, 250 m grid.
Residents are WorldPop 2025 people (100 m grid) inside each contour. Place names are OpenStreetMap points, not boundaries.
Daily and yearly totals multiply one departure by the departures per day and by 365 days.
